description: Genuine AMD SNP boot with public test keys and composite ML-DSA-65 and Ed25519 authorization; no operational trust. The rotated evidence makes a new online key active and retires the old one, and the pruned evidence omits the old key. The expiring evidence copies the first key manifest with an expiry one day after the boot. The evidence without collateral omits the AMD collateral of the boot platform, and the next revision adds it back as Control does when that boot registers.
